tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
3B21 Compatible Label Tape Replacement for TZ231 Laminated Label Maker Tape, for PT D200 D210 H100 1880 Vixic P3200 D210S, 12mm 0.47 Inch Black on White


  • Vixic 3B21 compatible tz tape 12mm 0.47 laminated white. Replace for Brother tze label tape TZe-231 TZe231 TZ-231 label maker refills. Color: Black on White; Size: 12mm (1/2'') x 8m (26.2feet).
  • Durable Indoor or outdoor labels. These Laminated label tapes are water resistant, grime resistant, grease resistant, temperature resistant, abrasion resistant, chemical resistant as well as fading resistant.
  • Easy to Apply: The split back of the tape is easy to remove, which makes the replacement label tape easy to peel and apply to multiple surfaces.
  • Suitable for Indoor and outdoor use. Normally used in office, factory, school, hospital, home, etc. Such as labeling folders, household products, components, electronic parts, power switch, etc. Pristar label tapes organize your workplace perfectly and make your work more efficient.
  • Compatible label maker: Vixic P3200, D210S.
